title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of two arcs and two lines. The first arc starts at coordinates (0.0, 0.1293), passes through (0.0379, 0.0379), and ends at (0.1293, 0.0). The first line runs from (0.1293, 0.0) to (0.6207, 0.0). The second arc begins at (0.6207, 0.0), goes through (0.7121, 0.0379), and concludes at (0.75, 0.1293). Finally, the second line connects back to the start point of the first arc at (0.0, 0.1293). Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0129 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The final dimensions of the knife should be 0.75 units in length, 0.1293 units in width, and 0.0129 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.1293) \
     .threePointArc((0.0379, 0.0379), (0.1293, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.6207, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.7121, 0.0379), (0.75, 0.1293)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1293) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0129)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.75      # X length
W = 0.1293    # Y width
T = 0.0129    # Z thickness

# Create a base rectangle on the XY plane
part = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0, W).lineTo(L, W).lineTo(L, W / 2) \
    .threePointArc((L - W / 2, 0.0), (L - W, 0.0)) \
    .lineTo(W, 0.0) \
    .threePointArc((W / 2, 0.0), (0.0, W / 2)) \
    .lineTo(0.0, W).close()

# Extrude to thickness
r = part.extrude(T)

import cadquery as cq

L = 0.7500
W = 0.1293
T = 0.0129
R = W / 2.0

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(R, 0.0)
    .lineTo(L - R, 0.0)
    .threePointArc((L, R), (L - R, W))
    .lineTo(R, W)
    .threePointArc((0.0, R), (R, 0.0))
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)
